title: Government Rails Site Hit Hours After CVE Patch
summary: A blog post reporting on how a government Ruby on Rails website was successfully exploited within hours of a CVE security patch being released, highlighting the critical vulnerability window between patch disclosure and actual deployment in production systems.
problem_solved: Illustrates the danger of delayed security patch deployment and the rapid exploitation of vulnerabilities after CVE disclosure.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary tale for organizations about the risks of slow patching processes, especially for critical government infrastructure.
